Chapter 362 - 362 Attack; Heal!

Chapter 362 - 362 Attack; Heal!

362 Attack; Heal!

Observation, smell, question, and pulse-taking were the methods of diagnosis in traditional medicine.

Some highly skilled doctors could judge a person’s physical condition with just a glance.

Lin Fan had obtained Sun Simiao’s Medical Experience. Sun Simiao was the king of medicine. Naturally, he was a brilliant traditional medicine practitioner.

Lin Fan could tell that there was something wrong with Riley’s body.

Moreover, the problem was huge!

Queen Ibai noticed that Lin Fan was staring at Riley and asked, “Mr. Lin, this is my great-granddaughter, Riley. What’s the matter?”

Even if he was staring at an ordinary girl, it was not a very polite thing to do.

Lin Fan said, “One minute. I estimate that she’ll faint in about one minute. She’ll be in critical condition!”

Chu Yunyue, the oval-faced woman, and the staff of Flower Stem…

Originally, they were extremely excited because of Queen Ibai’s arrival.

However, after hearing Lin Fan’s words, everyone froze.

What did Lin Fan mean?

One had to know that Queen Ibai had just said that Riley was her great-granddaughter, the princess of Eagle Country!

In the end, Lin Fan said that she was going to faint in one minute and would be in critical condition?!

What was this?

Was he cursing her?

He was cursing Eagle Country’s princess?

If Queen Ibai blamed him…

Because of Lin Fan’s words, the atmosphere turned heavy.

At this moment, Riley, who was looking around curiously, suddenly rolled her eyes and fell to the ground.

Queen Ibai’s heart tightened, and she hurriedly called out, “Doctor!”

The nobles beside her also shouted.

“Doctor, come quickly!”

…

When the queen went out, the doctor would always follow her.

He quickly ran over.

The doctor lifted Riley’s eyelids and listened to her heartbeat.

Then, he took out a syringe and injected it into Riley’s snow-white arm.

Obviously, the doctor had a deep understanding of Riley’s condition.

After doing this, the doctor heaved a sigh of relief and said, “Your Highness, she should wake up soon.”

In the past, the doctor had always treated Riley like this.

The effect was also very good.

However…

This time, after he finished speaking, Riley suddenly began to foam at the corner of her mouth, and her eyeballs kept rolling.

Seeing this…

The doctor’s heart tightened, and a layer of cold sweat instantly appeared on his forehead.

He quickly bent down and began to perform emergency treatment on Riley, but it was useless.

“Doctor, how is it?” Queen Ibai asked anxiously.

The doctor quickly said, “Maybe it’s because the dosage of the medicine isn’t enough. I’ll give the princess another injection.”

After saying that, he took out another syringe and was about to inject it into Riley’s arm.

t this moment, Lin Fan suddenly shouted, “Don’t inject anymore! Do you want her to die?”

Lin Fan was not a saint.

However, when he saw Riley fall ill in front of him…

For some reason, Lin Fan suddenly recalled the scene of his sister falling sick.

As he spoke, he pushed the doctor to the ground.

The guards thought that Lin Fan was a dangerous person and wanted to stop him.

At this moment, Lin Fan said, “I can save her!”

Lin Fan’s every sentence was translated by the interpreter.

When Queen Ibai heard this, she suddenly thought of what Lin Fan had said earlier.

‘One minute. She’ll faint in one minute and be in critical condition!”

“Everyone, stand down!” Queen Ibai hurriedly said.”

No one dared to disobey the queen’s orders!

The guards retreated.

Immediately, Queen Ibai, Jules Grant, Chu Yunyue, and everyone else focused their attention on Lin Fan.

Lin Fan opened a bottle of Flower Stem’s perfume and placed it by Riley’s nose.

About half a minute later, Riley stopped foaming.

Obviously, it had alleviated her symptoms.

Lin Fan thought for a moment and spent ten million yuan to buy a bottle of Medical Water from the system. He poured it into Riley’s mouth.

With Lin Fan’s current medical skills, even without the use of any healing potions, he could still completely cure Riley.

However, if Lin Fan were to save her, he would need to prescribe a prescription, get the medicine, and so on. It would be too troublesome.

Lin Fan hated trouble.

After consuming Medical Water, Riley slowly opened her eyes.

Riley saw that she was lying on the ground while Queen Ibai and everyone around her were looking at her. She said timidly, “Did… Did I get sick again?”

Seeing this…

Jules Grant could not help but heave a sigh of relief.

When Lin Fan pushed the doctor away and said that he could save Riley, his heart was in his throat.

Lin Fan was the second-largest shareholder of Eagle Country Oil Company.

At the same time, he was the one who introduced him to Queen Ibai.

If anything happened, he would definitely be unable to escape the responsibility!

The consequences would definitely be terrifying!

“Good, good! It’s good that you’re awake!” Queen Ibai said happily.

After a pause, she said, “Quickly thank Mr. Lin. He saved you.”

“Thank you…” Riley said timidly. “Mr. Lin.”

“You’re welcome,” said Lin Fan.

“I wonder what you used to save my Lil Riley?” Queen Ibai asked.

As she spoke, her slightly cloudy eyes landed on the Flower Stem perfume in Lin Fan’s hand.

Lin Fan did not hesitate and passed it over casually, “A bottle of perfume.”

Queen Ibai was slightly stunned.

A bottle of perfume?

He used perfume to wake up her great-granddaughter?

Queen Ibai slowly took the perfume with doubts in her heart. She placed it by her nose and sniffed it gently before nodding slightly.

Although the distance was quite far, when Lin Fan opened the bottle, Queen Ibai could still smell the fragrance.

At this moment, when she smelled it again, she could not help but praise, “What a nice smell. It has distinct layers. I like it very much.”

After a pause, she continued, “Mr. Lin… In the future, if Lil Riley falls ill again, will she only need to smell this perfume? Is there a way to cure her completely?”

As she said this, Queen Ibai’s usually calm face revealed an obvious look of anticipation.

She loved Riley very much. Every time she saw her fall ill, she felt very uncomfortable.

Unfortunately, no doctor could cure her.

Today, Queen Ibai saw a glimmer of hope.

Lin Fan said calmly, “Don’t worry, she won’t fall ill again.”

When Queen Ibai heard this, even she could not help but become excited.

“Really? Has she completely recovered?”

“Yes,” Lin Fan replied.

“That’s great!” Queen Ibai shouted excitedly.
